task: Wire the pure conveyor (src/minigames/restaurant/conveyor.js) into the Restaurant scene, replacing the kitchen counter, bell, ready cue and counter slots, per SPEC.md §4 'Conveyor (added 2026-09-14)'.
requirements: Remove the counter boxes, the bell, the rotating ready cue (readyCue/bellDome/updateReadyCue), SLOT_X slot placement, the bell sfx and the STRINGS.bellReady notice. No replacement 'dish ready' alert of any kind.

The turnaround host is not in the room during service. At beginTurnaround it appears standing in open dining-room floor, facing the camera, and asks the question as today; re-aim the closeup preset so nothing blocks the shot. No kitchen attendant replaces them.

Conveyor geometry: one straight belt in front of the back wall (back wall at z -7.35), spanning beyond both side walls (walls at x ±6.85) so its ends are never visible inside the room; belt top about 1.1 high, about 1.2 deep, dark belt surface between metal rails. At each side wall, a visible kitchen opening frame the belt passes through (dark recess, stainless trim, a little light/shelving inside). Direction right to left, fixed. Dishes are hidden while |x| >= 6.85 so they emerge from and disappear into the openings.

The belt surface visibly scrolls from conveyor.snapshot().beltTravel (texture offset or moving slats) whenever service is active, including when empty, and therefore freezes under speech focus and resumes in place.

A 'MATSUBARA RESTAURANT' environmental sign (mounted-letter look, canvas texture on a plane is fine) centred above the conveyor on the back wall, fully in frame and readable from the standard whole-room camera at 1366x768.

Each service frame: conveyor.advance(serviceDt, { dueOrders, carriedFood }). dueOrders = player-owned unresolved customers whose director 'ready' event has fired (preparation complete). Create a dish mesh (existing createDish) on 'enter', remove it on 'exit', and set every belt dish mesh x from the snapshot each frame.

Pickup: when not carrying and the player stands in the belt-front band, show the collect action for conveyor.nearestPickable(player.x, 1.4); interact takes it via take(). Clicking a belt dish walks to the belt front at the x from predictX(dishId, estimated walk seconds), clamped to ±visibleHalfWidth; on arrival collect that dish if within 1.6, otherwise the nearest pickable within 1.6. Clicking the belt itself walks to that belt-front point. Carrying is one dish; temperature is measured from pickup.

Dish return: a bus tub / return shelf in front of the right (entry) end of the belt, clearly separate from the belt. When carrying and within its radius, the action returns the dish (removed; supply recomputes on the next advance). No other penalty. Wrong delivery behaviour is unchanged.

Rival (difficulty 3): its pass becomes a small kitchen hatch in the left side wall, not on and not in front of the belt, never collectable by the player; pass the new position to createRival via passPosition. The rival never uses the belt.

Debug hook (frozen contract for the harness): replace readyDishes with conveyor: { direction, entryX, exitX, visibleHalfWidth, speed, beltTravel, dishes: [{ id, food, x, filler, screen }], pending: [{ food, dueAt, reentry }] }; add dishReturn: { position, screen }; sign: { text, visible, screen }; host: { inRoom, position }; legacy: { bell, readyCue, counter } booleans that must all be false; rename rivalPass to rivalHatch with the same inner shape. Keep carried, customers, player, rival and every other existing field.
Strings in src/config/lesson.js: remove bellReady; add a Japanese action label for returning a dish (e.g. 'おさらを もどす') and keep existing collect/deliver labels.
Keep director.js and rival.js logic unchanged except what the ready semantics and pass position strictly require; keep all existing unit tests passing and add tests for any new pure helper.
constraints: Do not add a food icon over a customer, a line/glow linking dish and table, a ticket, a label of the requested food, or automatic delivery.
Do not change the English (What food do you like? / I like pizza.), speech focus, dwell-to-talk, hold fallback, claims, rival state machine, scoring terms, or the whole-room camera framing.
Do not touch other minigames or scripts/playthrough*.mjs (the harness is a separate slice).
Visual/scene work: judge by rendering, not only tests. Report what you could not observe.
Edit files with structured file edits, never whole-file shell or regex rewrites.
